exposure: induction of anesthesia to delivery time (IADT)
outcome: rate of admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies delivered between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation with IADT ≥ 10 minutes
finding: There was no significant difference in neonatal outcomes, including arterial and venous cord pH, Apgar scores, NICU admission rates, and NICU length of stay, between general and regional anesthesia for cesarean deliveries with prolonged IADT.
